levels.name: Lantern Pass
levels.subtitle: 01 / THE FIRST WATCH
levels.description: The last wagons are crossing the forest. Keep the lantern line burning until they reach home.

levels.name: Rainstone Crossing
levels.subtitle: 02 / THE RIVER WATCH
levels.description: The river bends around the old stone crossing where the village keeps its river watch. Hold the causeway through the storm — the fields on both banks are the last shelter before the deep water.

levels.name: The Last Lantern
levels.subtitle: 03 / THE LAST WATCH
levels.description: The road climbs through the last lantern grove. Hold both bends until the Roadwarden and its column are turned back.

levels.name: The Divided Watch
levels.subtitle: 01 / MOSSWATER REACH
levels.description: Rats arrive on one trail, then the other. Skunk poison passes their shields. Build for both exits as the pressure joins.

waves.title: First one trail, then the other
Crossing guards
waves.lesson: Share splash coverage at the crossing.

levels.name: Two Quick Trails
levels.subtitle: 02 / MOSSWATER REACH
levels.description: Weasels threaten both exits from the start. Evade at bomb impact avoids blast and poison; an attached poison keeps ticking.

waves.title: Two quick arrivals
waves.lesson: Both lanes active; poison must connect at impact.

waves.title: The evading pairs
waves.lesson: Both lanes active; poison must connect at impact.

levels.name: The Tough-Skin Lesson
levels.subtitle: 03 / MOSSWATER REACH
levels.description: Iron Boars have armored, permanently poison-immune tough skin. Squirrel damage and Turtle nets buy the time you need; Skunk blasts still hurt.

waves.title: Tough skin
waves.lesson: Tough skin is permanently poison immune. Invest in direct damage and nets.

levels.subtitle: 04 / MOSSWATER REACH
levels.description: Rats shield, Weasels evade and Boars resist poison. Use your earned upgrades and a mix of direct damage, splash and slowing.

levels.name: The Twin Wardens
levels.subtitle: 05 / MOSSWATER REACH
levels.description: Guard both familiar exits. Two Roadwardens arrive together in wave five; each rallies its own route. Both must fall: either escaping loses.
